title: Identification through Heteroskedasticity in One Lemma: Partial Identification, an Eigenvalue Construction, and a Caution on Rank Tests
abstract: arXiv:2610.41361v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This teaching note unifies known results on identification through heteroskedasticity, under volatility regimes, GARCH, stochastic volatility and covariate-driven variances, in one lemma with a short linear-algebra proof. A shock is identified up to sign and labelling if and only if no other shock shares its variance path, and shocks that share a path are identified up to a rotation. The rows of the structural coefficient matrix solve one generalised eigenvalue problem that nests Rigobon's (2003) two-regime solution. Rank tests on second moments of the errors count at most linearly independent centred variance paths, not identified shocks. A simulation illustrates each point.

translated_title: 单一引理下的异方差识别：部分识别、特征值构造，以及对秩检验的警示
translated_abstract: 本教学短文通过一个简短的线性代数证明，将基于异方差的识别方法（涵盖波动率区制、GARCH、随机波动率以及协变量驱动的方差）的已知结果统一到一个引理之中。当且仅当没有其他冲击与其共享相同的方差路径时，一个冲击才能在符号和标记意义上被识别；共享同一方差路径的冲击则只能在旋转意义上被识别。结构系数矩阵的各行可通过求解一个广义特征值问题得到，该问题将 Rigobon (2003) 的双区制解作为特例包含在内。基于误差二阶矩的秩检验至多只能统计线性无关的中心化方差路径的个数，而非已识别冲击的个数。文中通过一个模拟实验对上述每一点进行了说明。
tldr: 本文用一个引理和一个广义特征值问题统一刻画了异方差（含波动率区制、GARCH、随机波动率等）下结构冲击的部分识别条件，并警示秩检验至多只能统计线性无关的方差路径数量而非已识别冲击的数量。
en_tdlr: This note unifies identification-through-heteroskedasticity results—spanning volatility regimes, GARCH, and stochastic volatility—in a single lemma and a generalized eigenvalue problem, showing that a shock is identified if and only if its variance path is unique, and cautioning that rank tests count only linearly independent variance paths, not identified shocks.
